original_test_intent: Execute the RVS IET single-module configuration on the approved GPU stack and verify every intended IET result complies with the AMD GPU specification.
original_method: Build immutable compatible ROCm/RVS artifacts, review and hash `iet_single.conf`, derive its expected action/target/metric roster without guessing IET semantics, run exact debug-3 command once under independent safety supervision, and compare complete outputs to approved limits.
manual_activity: GPU/RVS owner confirms what the approved IET config tests, its targets and metric limits, authorizes safety envelope and sets verdict.
required_inputs: Pinned ROCm/RVS revisions/checksums and build environment
IET expected action/target/metric roster and GPU-model limits
Supported platform matrix and secure execution identity
Thermal/power/time/error abort, OOB recovery and cleanup plan
safety_requirements: No unreviewed latest-source fetch during run
Use independent timeout and one attempt
Abort/recover on unsafe threshold, hang, reset or unexpected action
agent_execution_scope: Verify build and IET config against approval
Run exact iet_single debug-3 command once
Capture and reconcile every declared action/metric plus health
Report without guessing IET scope or setting DUT verdict
engineer_actions: Disposition all outputs/health and decide outcome

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Parse the reviewed config into an expected-action manifest, bind it to binary/config hashes and targets, then reconcile all emitted actions/metrics and platform health.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Makes the otherwise undefined IET-to-spec criterion traceable without inventing module meaning.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No generic RVS invocation or adjacent module satisfies iet_single coverage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The source alone does not define IET subactions or numeric limits; those remain engineering inputs.

project_override_considerations: Engineering must approve the IET module's intended action set and model-specific acceptance directly from the pinned config/tool revision.
expected_evidence: IET config hash/schema and expected action/target/metric manifest
Complete action/metric versus spec table including missing/extra actions

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently specifies iet_single; the historical generic path is incomplete, not a competing authoritative case.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Config semantics, limits, artifacts and safety approvals can be provided.

review_improvement: Anchors the IET review to a config-derived action manifest, avoiding unsupported interpretation of the module name.
independent_technical_reasoning: The acronym alone is insufficient to infer what this RVS revision's IET config executes. Static review must derive actions, targets and metrics from the pinned config/schema and ensure output has neither missing nor unexpected actions. This also prevents a generic iet.conf from silently changing coverage while still producing a successful process exit.
